text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't even come close! How is<n>she so much
better than me?!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan has won the spring<n>shield! What an
incredible display of<n>might from the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Ryan! I bet the whole<n>Mejiro family is
just beaming with<n>pride right now!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... She's practically shaking with<n>joy! I wonder
what she's going to<n>say...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the<n>Mejiro family!
And at the Takarazuka<n>Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will
show you<n>once again that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll all keep cheering for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(If I was standing there victorious<n>right now, I'd
probably just scream<n>with joy.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But not Ryan... She prioritized<n>thanking her fans
over celebrating her<n>own victory.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Now that's someone who's lived<n>shouldering
expectations. That's<n>what separates me and her...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! At the<n>Takarazuka Kinen,
that's gonna be<n>me!
